description: This Java class 'ProductPriceController' is a Spring MVC controller managing product pricing operations in an e-commerce admin interface. It includes methods for viewing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product price details, as well as paging through product prices. The class interacts with service layer components such as ProductService and ProductPriceService, handles validation, and manages view rendering and JSON responses.

classes.name: ProductPriceController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing product prices in admin panel.

methods.name: getProductPrices
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product pricing page for a specified product ID.

methods.name: pagePrices
methods.description: Handles POST request to retrieve paginated list of product prices as a JSON response.

methods.name: editProductPrice
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the form for editing a specific product price.

methods.name: displayCreateProductPrice
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the form for creating a new product price.

methods.name: displayProductPrice
methods.description: Prepares and displays the product price form with existing or default data.

methods.name: saveProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a product price, including validation.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a product price and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set menu attributes in the model for view rendering.
